name: discord-csv2ass
description: Discord CSV log to ASS subtitle converter
author: Ihurah_com

scripts.prestart: npm run prepare-youtube-emojis && npm run build-ui
scripts.prebuild: npm run prepare-youtube-emojis && npm run build-ui
scripts.build: electron-packager . "Discord CSV2ASS" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --overwrite --asar.unpack="**/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg.exe" --icon=assets/icon --out=dist --ignore="^/(dist|tests|renderer|scripts|[.]agents)($|/)|^/(build-installer[.]js|package-lock[.]json)$" --win32metadata.CompanyName="Discord CSV2ASS" --win32metadata.FileDescription="Discord CSV2ASS" --win32metadata.ProductName="Discord CSV2ASS" --win32metadata.InternalName="Discord CSV2ASS"
